quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on maintaining a next-game mindset after a loss

quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate is keeping a next game mindset after the loss to Atlanta. He says the team will adjust and look to fix their mistakes in practice tomorrow.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on the importance of setting the tone at home
quotes.excerpt: Especially, you know, home game, we trying to set the tone, right? I think that's the most important part.
